name: @gonvex/cloudflare
description: Gonvex backend on Cloudflare Workers and Durable Objects (one SQLite-backed object per tenant).

scripts.typecheck: wrangler types --include-runtime=false --check && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p kernel/host/tsconfig.json --noEmit && cd control && wrangler types --include-runtime=false --check && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && cd .. && tsc -p kernel/files/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test: vitest run && vitest run --root kernel/host && vitest run --root control && node --test scripts/deploy-preview.test.mjs && vitest run --root kernel/files
